minimum.$description: Minimum pointer target size aligned to WCAG 2.2 AA target size guidance. At a default 16px root size, this equals 24px.

comfortable.$description: Preferred comfortable interactive target size. At a default 16px root size, this equals 44px.

compact.$description: Minimum vertical size for compact interactive controls. Keeps controls accessible even when padding or text size is compact.

default.$description: Default minimum vertical size for interactive controls such as buttons, inputs, selects and tabs.

comfortable.$description: Larger minimum vertical size for comfortable or prominent interactive controls.
